verdict.rationale: Semgrep is an application security scanner, so container image scanning is a fair axis to ask about. However, the evidence only documents source-code SAST, secrets detection, and SCA of repository dependencies via manifest parsing. Nothing shows scanning of built container images or their OS packages. Rule-based scanning of configuration files and manifest-based dependency analysis are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan container images for OS-package and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploying them
